findingDetails.title: New surfaces allowlist row has no regression test
findingDetails.case: the commit adds a third ALLOWED row (check surfaces, file sk-code-opencode/assets/checklists/agent-authoring.md, line substring mirror it across all three surfaces) so the registry-derived count tolerates one checklist line that counts runtime agent directories, but no test hub writes that path, so removing the row or editing its line substring leaves the suite green
findingDetails.evidence: buildHub writes ROUTER.md, mode-registry.json, shared refs, a demo packet, sk-code-quality/SKILL.md, a changelog and a benchmark report, never agent-authoring.md (verify-doc-claims.test.cjs:47-64); the only allowlist assertion exercises the names check (test:95-102); the new surfaces coverage tests counts only (test:227-238); rg over scripts/tests for agent-authoring or mirror it across returns no match
findingDetails.userImpact: a doc reword or a typo in the row turns the live wrapper red with no failing unit test explaining why; detection is fail-closed and noisy, never a silent pass
findingDetails.scopeProof: full read of both files in scripts/tests (the directory holds exactly these two); no fixture writes the allowlisted path; the row's live-tree match was verified in iteration 1, so the gap is regression coverage only
findingDetails.recommendation: add the allowed line to a fixture hub and assert PASS check surfaces, plus one negative in another file
findingDetails.confidence: high on the omission, medium on impact
findingDetails.downgradeTrigger: another test outside the two reviewed files writes that path and asserts the surfaces allowlist

findingDetails.title: Count vocabulary is encoded twice and the both-case fallback is positional
findingDetails.case: the word-to-number vocabulary in COUNT_WORDS and the word alternation inside SURFACE_COUNT_WORDING restate one list, and the lookup falls back to 2 for any match without a capture group, which silently serves the both supported surfaces pattern
findingDetails.evidence: COUNT_WORDS maps two through ten at :45 while the regex at :46 repeats the same alternation; :331 computes stated as m[1] ? COUNT_WORDS[m[1].toLowerCase()] : 2, and only the second pattern in the array lacks a capture group, so the default is load-bearing and unnamed
findingDetails.userImpact: the next editor who extends one representation without the other gets says undefined failures on true wording; no current input triggers it and dev cost only
findingDetails.scopeProof: the two constants are adjacent and self-contained; the only other reader is the loop that consumes them
findingDetails.recommendation: derive the alternation from Object.keys(COUNT_WORDS) or assert agreement at load, and name the both-case instead of the positional fallback
findingDetails.confidence: high on the structure, low on impact
findingDetails.downgradeTrigger: a derivation or load-time assertion tying the two representations together
